name: CoolAir — clean HVAC corporate

source.template: CoolAir – Air Conditioning & Heating HVAC HTML template (index.html)
source.method: Computed styles measured in Chromium at 1440px (scripts/extract-template.mjs → measured.json); reference-1..5.jpg are the full page in order.

character: Calm, premium, corporate HVAC. One geometric sans (Manrope) with tight negative tracking on big headings, soft pill eyebrow labels above every heading, generous 100px section rhythm, rounded 10–20px photo corners, a two-blue palette (deep navy + light periwinkle) on white and a pale blue-grey alt surface. Feels like a well-run regional HVAC company, not a flyer.
reuse: Use for HVAC / air conditioning / heating / cooling / ventilation / plumbing / appliance-repair / home-services leads that should feel trustworthy, modern and premium. Put the lead's brand colour in the navy 'primary' slot, derive the light 'accent' as a lighter tint of it, and use their real technician/van/equipment photos.

primary.note: Single family for everything. Headings are weight 600 (not 800) with NEGATIVE tracking — that tight, elegant look is the signature. Body is a light grey (#7b8893) with very open 1.81 line-height.

scale.note: pill: padding 2px 15px, radius 30px, pale bg #f4f7fb (or accent bg with white text, or 10% white on dark)
big number + small unit (%/+) set smaller, then a 16px label

color.notes: Two tones of ONE hue: a deep primary and a light tint. Map the lead's brand colour to primary and generate the light tint for accent. Sections alternate white / #f4f7fb; the only full-colour bands are the CTA strip and footer.

spacing.container: 1280px max content column with 32px side padding (20px under 768px) — the SAME column for top bar, header, every section and footer. (Template measured 1200px; standardised to 1280 so every mockup shares one grid.)
spacing.sectionPaddingY: 100px top and bottom (sections that follow each other often use 0 top / 100 bottom so the rhythm stays 100px, never doubled)
spacing.headingStack: eyebrow pill → 16px → h2 → 20px → 18px intro paragraph → 50px → content grid
spacing.cardPadding: 40px inside card text area; image on top at 376×250 (3:2)
spacing.iconBox: 64×64 square, radius 10px, primary bg, white check/icon (why-choose list); 80×80 circle accent bg in hero feature row
spacing.hero: 900px tall full-bleed photo with navy overlay (~rgba(10,37,64,.55)), content centred, top bar 40px + header 80px overlaid on the photo

components.topBar: 40px navy bar: phone · email · hours on the left (14px white, small icons), social icons right.
components.header: Transparent over hero, 80px: logo left, centred nav (15px/600 white, dropdown chevrons), ONE CTA button right in the accent colour ('Schedule Now').
components.button: 8px radius, 5px 25px padding (≈39–44px tall), 15px/700. Primary = navy; secondary = accent periwinkle; on cards a 'Read more' ghost (10% white on coloured cards, #e9eef5 on light cards).
components.serviceCard: 3-up, 376px wide, radius 20px, photo 250px tall on top with a 70×70 white/colour icon tile (radius 10) overlapping its top-left at 30px inset; body padding 40px; h4 20/700; 16px body; 'Read more' small button. The THREE cards use three different fills: pale #f4f7fb, accent, primary — a signature move.
components.whyChooseList: 3×2 grid, each item = 64px rounded-square icon (primary, alternate rows accent) + h4 + 3-line text, 24px gap.
components.processSteps: 4 equal cards in a row, accent bg, radius 12, padding 30, small 'Step 1' chip (10% white) above an h4; arrows between cards.
components.statsCollage: Left: eyebrow + h2 + long paragraph. Right: a 2×2 masonry of 270px photos (radius 10) and two stat tiles — one pale (#f4f7fb) with ink number, one primary with white number.
components.testimonialCard: Pale card radius 20, 80px round avatar with white ring, quote glyph in accent top-left, name 16/700, 'Customer' label, 16px centred quote, 5 gold stars.
components.faq: Two columns on #f4f7fb: rounded photo left (radius 20, headset icon tile), accordion right — 16/600 questions with 1px #dfe5ee dividers and chevrons, 20px row padding.
components.ctaBanner: Rounded (20px) primary-coloured box inside the container, photo filling the left half, right side: pill eyebrow '24 Hours & Emergencies' + the phone number at 42px/600 white with a phone icon.
components.footer: Primary strip (40px padding) with a check icon + 26px statement + accent button, then #0a2540 footer: logo + about text, two link columns, and a big 42px phone number column; 1px divider and a copyright row.

blueprint.spec: 40px bar + 80px header over the hero photo

900px full-bleed photo slider with navy overlay. Centred: pill eyebrow → 64px/600 (-3px tracking) 2-line headline → 24px subline → one navy button. At the bottom of the hero, INSIDE it, a 3-column feature row: 80px accent circle icon + white h4 + two lines of text.

padding 50/100. 12-col grid: 576×447 photo (radius 20) left, text column right starting at col 7: pill eyebrow, 42px h2, paragraph, navy button. Under it a full-width row of 6 badge/cert logos (156px) — use only real certifications/brands from FACTS, otherwise omit.
padding 0/100, centred heading stack, 3 service cards (pale / accent / primary fills) with photo tops.
#f4f7fb band, padding 100/100, centred heading stack, 3×2 icon list.
Full-container rounded photo with dark overlay, pill eyebrow + 42px white statement left, a 320px portrait (radius 10) of the owner/tech on the right, with name + role; navy button.
centred heading stack, 4 accent step cards with arrows.
text left, 2×2 photo + stat tile masonry right (only real numbers from FACTS).
centred heading stack, carousel of 3.5 visible pale cards with avatar, quote, stars, dots below.
#f4f7fb band, centred heading, photo left + accordion right.
rounded primary box with photo half + huge phone number.
'Brands we work with' 20px h4 centred, 5 logos in a row (only brands in FACTS).

signatureMoves: Pill eyebrow above EVERY section heading
Negative letter-spacing on the display (-3px) and h2 (-1.25px)
Three service cards in three different fills of the same hue
Hero contains the feature row at its bottom edge
Section intro paragraph 18px, light grey, centred under the h2
